messages:
monica: quick sync — acceptance criteria & ops checklist for graceful-degrade paths. throwing a short draft below, want objections or known gaps before next canary. TL;DR: define probe, trigger, mitigation order, telemetry signals, rollback.

sam: +1. include explicit p99/p95 windows and minimum traffic sample size. also we need tenant-level opt-outs.

kevin: to add: model-variant compatibility table — which quantized models are safe for which tenants. don't auto-fall back to cheaper model if eval delta > 2% relative for rerank workloads.

maria-pm: also map customer SLAs -> prefer routing to Dedicated instead of lower-quality model when SLA==enterprise.

monica: draft triggers:
```
- probe_window: 60s
- sample_min_requests: 100
- p99_latency_threshold_pct: 20
- error_rate_threshold_pct: 1
- quality_regression_threshold: 0.03 (relative scoring drop)
```
let me know if numbers seem aggressive.

sam: looks reasonable. runtime caveat: need probe isolation — don't let probes share batching caches with production; otherwise you get false negatives.

infra-bot: reminder: canary policy experiments only run in us-west-2 by default. Use `--region=all` to opt-in.

kevin: ops runbook sketch:
1) detect -> annotate span
2) trigger fallback -> route to pre-warmed lower-tier pool (same model family)
3) start async quality eval on sample
4) if quality delta > threshold -> rollback fallback and alert SRE+ML
5) extend prewarm if canary shows recovery

maria-pm: question: who owns the 'quality eval' quick script? ML or SRE?

kevin: ML should own eval harness; SRE owns orchestration hooks. keep separation.

jen: worry: rollback loop risk. add cooldown per-tenant 10m and global circuit breaker to avoid oscillation.

monica: good call. updated rule: cooldown=10m, global-cooldown=2m on thundering fallback events.

sam: can we add a simple metric name convention? e.g., routing.fallback.{tenant}.{reason} and trace span `fallback.decision`.

monica: yes — add to telemetry doc. I'll open a follow-up PR with concrete metric names.

kevin: small nit: ensure 'fallback' logic doesn't bypass auditing for Private deployments (audit logs must still record model id + fallback_reason).

monica: noted. ok if no one objects I'll merge this as an RFC follow-up doc tomorrow. :thumbsup:

maria-pm: :+1:

deploy-bot: canary-policy-checklist workflow started for branch `graceful-degrade-rfc` — checks: lint, sim, prewarm
